# Axis Meter Solutions
> Axis Meter Solutions provides utility submetering, billing, leak detection, and metering services for multifamily, commercial, mixed-use, and institutional properties across the United States and Canada.

## Core Pages
- [Home](https://axismeter.com): Overview of Axis Meter Solutions, service benefits, markets served, and consultation options.
- [About](https://axismeter.com/about): Company background, values, partners, and service approach.
- [How It Works](https://axismeter.com/how-it-works): Step-by-step submetering process from consultation through installation and billing.
- [Contact](https://axismeter.com/contact): Contact form and consultation request page.
- [FAQ](https://axismeter.com/faq): Common questions for property owners, residents, and technical stakeholders.

## Solutions
- [Utility Submetering Solutions](https://axismeter.com/solutions): Overview of electricity, water, gas, thermal, common area, and leak detection services.
- [Electricity Submetering](https://axismeter.com/solutions/electricity-submetering): Per-unit electricity metering, automated readings, and tenant billing.
- [Water Submetering](https://axismeter.com/solutions/water-submetering): Water metering with conservation insights and leak detection support.
- [Thermal Submetering](https://axismeter.com/solutions/thermal-submetering): Heating and cooling metering for hydronic, fan coil, VRF, and district energy systems.
- [Gas Submetering](https://axismeter.com/solutions/gas-submetering): Natural gas submetering and billing for multi-unit properties.
- [Common Area Metering](https://axismeter.com/solutions/common-area-metering): Metering for lobbies, hallways, parking, amenities, and other shared spaces.
- [Leak Detection](https://axismeter.com/solutions/leak-detection): Leak and flood detection monitoring included with submetering installs.

## Feature Pages
- [Multifamily Utility Billing Services](https://axismeter.com/features/multifamily-utility-billing): Tenant billing for apartments, condos, and multi-unit communities.
- [Thermal Metering Services](https://axismeter.com/features/thermal-metering): Heat energy and cooling measurement for billing-ready thermal metering programs.
- [Revenue-Grade Submeters](https://axismeter.com/features/revenue-grade-submeters): Compliant submetering hardware and data workflows for billing and audit-sensitive environments.
- [Lease-to-Bill Utility Metering](https://axismeter.com/features/lease-to-bill-utility-metering): Utility metering programs aligned to lease billing, occupancy, move-ins, and move-outs.
- [Utility Metering Installation and Maintenance](https://axismeter.com/features/utility-metering-installation-maintenance): Turnkey meter installation, commissioning, maintenance, and support.

## Utility Pages
- [Thermal Energy Metering for Multi-Unit Properties](https://axismeter.com/utilities/thermal-energy-metering): Heating and cooling energy measurement, tenant billing setup, compliance support, and ongoing maintenance.

## Markets
- [Residential Rentals](https://axismeter.com/markets/residential-rentals): Submetering for apartments and multifamily rental properties.
- [Condominiums](https://axismeter.com/markets/condos): Submetering for condo corporations, strata councils, and owner communities.
- [Commercial Properties](https://axismeter.com/markets/commercial): Utility cost recovery for office, retail, and commercial tenants.
- [Mixed-Use Properties](https://axismeter.com/markets/mixed-use): Unified metering and billing for residential and commercial tenant mixes.
- [Student Housing](https://axismeter.com/markets/student-housing): Submetering for university and college residences.
- [Affordable Housing](https://axismeter.com/markets/affordable-housing): Fair utility billing and conservation support for community housing.
